summary: Smoke testing of AbarrotesPOS (POS + Inventario + Facturas OCR + Contactos + Reportes). Backend endpoints (seed, products, barcode, sales, contacts, reports/summary) all respond 200. Frontend: full POS happy path works end-to-end (barcode add, product-card click, qty controls, checkout efectivo, receipt POS-000003). Navigation across all main modules (Panel, POS, Inventario, Facturas, Reportes, Clientes, Proveedores) works. Placeholder 'pronto' pages render. Mobile hamburger opens sidebar correctly. Inventario CRUD create tested successfully.
passed: POST /api/sales creates sale POS-000002 (fields qty & subtotal required)
POST /api/contacts creates cliente OK; GET /api/contacts?kind=cliente lists it
Dashboard renders Ventas hoy $7.000, Productos 12, Bajo stock 1, chart 'Ventas últimos días', top vendidos
POS: search filter, barcode-add (Arroz), click product card adds to cart, cart total in COP recalculates ($2.500 -> $5.000)
POS checkout: efectivo + received $50.000 confirmed, receipt POS-000003 shown with format POS-XXXXXX
Inventario: new-product-btn opens form, created 'Producto Test QA' visible in list
Nav to Facturas: dropzone and model-select visible
Reportes: page shows POS- sale numbers
Mobile 390x844: open-sidebar hamburger visible; mobile-sidebar opens with nav items

failed.issue: Section titled 'Ventas últimos días' instead of expected 'Ventas diarias' (spec wording mismatch)
failed.evidence: innerText check for 'Ventas diarias' = False; screenshot shows 'Ventas últimos días'

failed.issue: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (payment dialog, receipt dialog)
failed.evidence: Console warnings printed 4x: 'Warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'

action_items: Optional: rename dashboard section title to 'Ventas diarias' if strict wording is required.
Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Payment/Receipt dialogs to silence a11y warnings.

Not tested in this smoke pass: real OCR call to /api/invoices/ocr with Gemini (UI verified only); /api/invoices/import; full Inventario edit/delete; Clientes/Proveedores CRUD via UI. Recommend full-agent regression.
